partners.mechanism_chain: ELOVL4 pathogenic variant —DISRUPTS→ ELOVL4 (HGNC:3091); ELOVL4 (HGNC:3091) —DECREASES→ Very long-chain fatty acid biosynthesis (GO:0006635); Very long-chain fatty acid biosynthesis (GO:0006635) —LEADS_TO→ Retinal degeneration (HP:0000507); ELOVL4 (HGNC:3091) —DECREASES→ Neuronal development and maintenance (GO:0048666); Neuronal development and maintenance (GO:0048666) —LEADS_TO→ Cerebellar ataxia (HP:0001251).
